avis.titre: I would keep buying again and again
avis.texte: Love those product. Foamy and inviting when you cleanse your face. Very mild for sensitive skin.
I love how clean my skin feels after using this cleanser. It is "squeaky clean". You don't need much of this product at all since it foams up on your skin.
Foaming cleanser is the best way for me to quickly and thoroughly clean my face. Leaves my skin soft and smooth.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: I use it in the shower and I love the clean feeling I get. It's soft on my sensitive skin. Highly recommended.
absolutely love this facial cleanser. It provides gentle, delicate cleansing for my skin!
I have been a devoted fan of this cleanser for years. Just love to wash my face with this soft foam. There's no other product for me.

avis.titre: I definitely will buy and recommend this product again.
avis.texte: I have come to love this cleaning product. It is gentle, easy, and really cleans my face well. It might be the best cleanser I have used. This brand's products are high-quality, and they have a proven reputation.
I'm on my 4th bottle, it's gentle but does it's job of cleansing my face, very economical too, one bottle would last me 2-3 months. Love this!

I use this wash when I wear makeup because I know it's cleaning it off without leaving any left on! Its light, smells good and still feels like it's leaving skin hydrated after using, if your tried of wash not taking off your makeup then this is the one for ya.
Love this cleanser! It also acts as a makeup remover when putting it direction your face.

avis.titre: Not sure I would purchase again
avis.texte: The cleanser is creamy and doesn't dry out my skin, but it doesn't remove all of my eye makeup.

Compared to the clarifying cleansing foam or the oil cleanser, this micro foam is much better. It lathers really well and feels like it does get rid of the dirt on my face. I love the texture and it didn't leave my skin feeling dry.
I use this daily! I love the feel of the micro foam, it's so silky and smooth. My skin is left feeling great! Highly recommend.
I got this product initially as a tester, and I immediately fell in love. It works great and always leaves my skin feeling fresh. I definitely recommend.

Ugh. I really wanted to love this. The consistency of the foam is initially great, but I had hoped to use this like the Perfect Cleansing Oil and, oh my god, the burn in the eyes. If you're in need of something that takes off eye makeup, do not recommend it. The cleansing foam tends to leave a sticky feeling on the skin after rinsing, and I've noticed some new breakouts since its use (even after double cleansing). I think nothing compares to the OG Shiseido Perfect Cleansing Oil for makeup removal!
I purchased this cleanser after trying the Clarifying Cleansing Foam and finding it drying. This Microfoam is more gentle, not drying at all. Only bummer is I'm going thru this product much faster.
My favourite!! Excellent and you are feelling like a put some cream after the cleaning!
Easiest and most efficient way to wash your face. Mom and I use it twice a day every day. Works great with your hands or with a charcoal sponge. Rinses clean and foams great.
Cleanser that removes waterproof mascara but isn't harsh or irritating to sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Would not recommend for young/sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin, and this cleanser was too rough. Some gentle cleansers aren't too exfoliating, but this one is. It is harsh and broke my skin barrier, forming zits in my skin. Do not buy unless you have mature skin.

avis.titre: Would not recommend for young/sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin, and this cleanser was too rough. Some gentle cleansers aren't too exfoliating, but this one is. It is harsh and broke my skin barrier, forming zits in my skin. Do not buy unless you have mature skin.

avis.titre: Sheseido Foaming Face Wash for the Win!
avis.texte: I have used this product over 20 years. I was first introduced to Sheseido at a high end cosmetic counter. I quickly switched to all of the skin care line. I have required products that are gentle on the sensitive skin. The foaming face wash does everything I expect for my skin type and skincare expectations. This is by far my favorite go to product for everyday use as I typically do not wear any foundation-even at my age.

I bought this trying to find something gentle on my skin. This cleanser is so light and fluffy; I love the way it feels like it has microscopic scrubs scrubbing my face as the bubbles bubble my face. I love how gentle it is on my skin.
Very light to touch and cleanses really well. I recommend it!
The texture of this foam is absolutely divine. It doesn't upset my sensitive skin, and cleans thoroughly am without leaving my skin tight or uncomfortable.
This product cleans well, feels great and a little goes a long way

I had been using the other Shishedo Cleansers (and make-up) prior to this purchase, so I am very familiar with this line. This COMPLETE CLEASING MICROFOAM is certainly more gentle than the tubes, yet effective! I suggest using both the Shishedo Foam(s) and this MICROFOAM, alternating times or days.
I love this cleanser it is absolutely amazing in my skin, I like using this to remove my makeup and it works wonders 10 out of 10 recomendado!!
I just try to use them for a while and now looks at my skin very smoothy . I also use Serum and sunscreen on my face every day.
Amazing cleanser. I really love this brand and using the microfoam cleanser was no exception. It's so smooth and soft on your skin, you can really feel it doing wonders.

avis.titre: Perfect for summer or oily skin
avis.texte: First off my face has never felt more clean and I've noticed a huge difference in how my pores look around my nose. I bought this at a discount recently and I've been really enjoying it. One pump gives you more than enough of a frothy wash. It's gentle around the eyes and takes all my makeup off. The only reason I rated this 4 stars is because it leaves my face feeling the tiniest bit tight afterwards and I wouldn't be able to use this in the winter.
I've gone through so many cleansers and could never find one that didn't dry out my face or leave my skin peeling until this one. I love the way it makes my skin feel and look!

Bought this at Marshall's and had not tired beforehand. I wanted something different brand wise and stumbled upon Shiseido after a friend's recommendation. Cleanses really well and leaves skin feeling refreshed and clear. Great for everyday usage.

I was originally sent Shiseido products to test for free. I purchased this product with my own money because I liked the brand so much. I would not have spent so much on a cleanser before but I love the results and quality of this product. I live in a dry climate and battle dry skin year round so I'm always looking for products that hydrate and don't dry my skin.
Loving this cleanser. Gentle on skin. All good ingredients on your face. You get what you paid for. Definitely purchasing this again.

I was using Cerave to cleanse but always felt like my skin had buildup on it. With this product, my skin feels so soft, clean and moisturized. I won't use another face wash ever. I do wish it was better for removing eye makeup, but I've got a work around for that.

And amaizing foam I have to say it removes all dirty from the face and leaves the skin ready for the serums and creams you want go apply after use it ,is so good , I use it with makeup or without makeup and it works every time Did you say the complete links in microphone for all skin types is so good for it you can pump 2 or 3 times and gently massage form over overface and rice throughly is so good honestly it's very good I never experienced a micro foam like this one. It can be a little expensive for someone's budget but it's very good and I totally recommend it

I've always had to use multiple products to get make-up off. Wipes, balms, cleansers, exfoliants, eye removers, and still my makeup wouldn't completely break down. I was skeptical when I was recommended this, and when I got home and saw that it was a light, airy foam, I literally thought to myself "yeah right!" But UNBELIEVABLY, I lathered my face and ALL of my make up came right off! My skin has never felt this clean after wearing make up and I can't believe I only have to use one product! It does make my skin a little on the drier side, but even that has been helping my blackheads clear out.. and following with a good moisturizer is key :)

I have gone through so many bottles of this cleanser and I always make sure I have a backup so I am never without. It removes makeup so effortlessly and does not dry out the skin. It's a double win! The only thing I do not like is the price but it hasn't stopped me from continuing buying.

I'm not usually a fan of foaming cleanser, but this stuff is an absolute dream. The packaging is beautiful, it foams right out of the pump, and it feels like washing your face with a luxurious cloud. It rinses clean and doesn't dry out my skin. Amazing!

I have been a loyal Shiseido customer since the line was re-introduced to the US in the 80s. I started out using the blue line and then progressed to Benefiance. When Shiseido discontinued the Softening Lotion, I was not happy but I stuck with them. I have tried several products from their other lines but never saw the same results as with Benefiance. Now they have discontinued the Benefiance cleanising foam that was really what kept me loyal to the line.This Complete Cleansing Microfoam left my face feeling oily after i was done rinsing it off. I hate it. I know they are trying to force their mature customers to buy the significantly more expensive Revitalizing cleanser but I've tried it and found it to be too creamy. After all this time-maybe it's time to find another brand.
I love this cleanser. It does not leave my skin tight but cleanses well.
I like this product, And it last a long time, Only a small amount is needed.
I have been using this cleansing foam for a couple of years now and absolutely love it! My skin feels wonderful, not dry or with make up residues. Just perfect!
I have been using Shisiedo for over 15 years now and wouldn't change a thing, but they have progressing and their products just keep getting better
I have been using this product for years and is excellent on my face so happy.
This product has softened my skin as well as cleared up some minor skin issues. Really love this product!

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: I love this foaming cleanser!!! You don't need a lot — just one pump & it does a great job in cleaning your face
Got a chance to buy it this Black Friday. It was an extremely right decision I had made. Every time cleaning my face using this foam, it leaves a very smooth and soft facial skin.

avis.titre: Love, love, love this cleansing foam!
avis.texte: This cleansing foam is amazing. Skin feels really clean yet is moisturized and soft.
First time with this cleanser. I absolutely love it. Removes all make-up and your face does not feel like you washed away its nature moisture.

This is an awesome it removes any water proof makeup. This product meet all my expectations. I would not change this product for any other product. The price is decent.. I would definitely recommend this to my friends.
This cleanser is ok. It has foam but not as much as the extra creamy that's discontinued ,which was my favourite.
very good product. but it doesn't remove my kohl liner make up properly.
I bought this a month ago, this feature is perfect for the skins. Love
I have used many difference brand and I stop looking after I use this product. LOVE IT.

Almost through my first bottle and will definitely be repurchasing. This stuff gets off makeup, including mascara, and gently cleans your face. If you have sensitive skin like me, this is perfect. I couldnt be happier with this cleanser!
I love this product. It's easy to use and saves time. It's also gentle on my skin.
Cleansing foam is very light and airy so it lathers up more than you can feel on your face. Face feels clean after using.
I am so happy with the results of this cleansing foam, it removes very well the make up while cleaning and softing my skin.
It really cleans my skin and it leaves a soft touch after using. After using it for a couple week I can see a difference from before using.
This cleansing foam feels like nothing else I've used before. Very light on skin and makes me feel refreshed after use, definitely one of my favorite products.
Alcohol in the complete cleansing microfoam enlarged my pores. Sodium lauryl sulfate also in the complete cleansing microfoam dried my skin.
I absolutely love this cleanser! Smells great and works well. Very gently cleans skin.

I bought this several months ago because I have dry skin and wanted a makeup remover. This product is amazing. The rich foam lifts even the most stubborn makeup off the skin without drying you out. My skin was left soft and supple. The more I used it the better my skin looked. I will continue to use it.

Got this during the 21 days of beauty sale because I was running low on my philosophy cleanser (has been my HG cleanser for removing makeup). I was so surprised at how easily it took my makeup off. One pump (maybe even half) is all it takes! I don't have to go back in with more like I sometimes would with my philosophy cleanser. It doesn't feel like it's tugging or stripping my skin of moisture. Super amazing. Recommend 100%

This cleanser leaves your skin feeling refreshed, soft and smooth. It doesnt remove waterproof eyeliner or mascara. I use a different cleanser for that. It has a nice lather. You can use this on dry skin but I havent tried it that way yet.
I bought this weeks ago and love it! I have oily skin but it cleans my skin very well while not rendering it dry. Absolutely fantastic :)
Removes all makeup even waterproof. You don't need much product. I love that it leaves my skin smooth and not dry after cleansing
I change my face cleaner multiple time and finally I found this that works really well especially with cleansing blush and good price point. Recommended!!!!
This cleanser cleans all my makeup off without leaving my skin dry and overstripped, great for dry aging skin and after an oil cleanser.
